meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, nobody called me first, and I want to know who decided that and on what basis.
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.

A rewrite for what, Hale? You haven't shown me a single thing, and if I take a rewrite now I'm admitting there was something to rewrite. You still haven't told me who decided on the zero, or why nobody called me before it went into the gradebook.
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
Generous. I'm not most parents, Hale, and I'm writing down that you're offering a rewrite without showing me any evidence. Who decided on the zero?
Will you take it or not?
No. Not until you show me what this zero is based on, and who entered it without calling me first.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology, and a written explanation of who decided on it, on what basis, and why I was not contacted before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed in her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on who decided and why nobody called her first, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because no evidence was heard.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never showed her anything dated that she could check against Owen's own work.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing any evidence and then leaned on her to take it, which to her would have meant admitting something, and pressure is not evidence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your case never came near that night because you showed no evidence at all, and in any case it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opened by asking who decided and why nobody called her, own entering the zero before contacting her in one sentence, then show her one specific, dated piece of Owen's own work she can check, and only after that offer the rewrite under procedure 4.4.
